title: Per-Component Hover and Vertex Spheres
description: Wgpu renderer cursor parity with React: theme-aware custom SVG cursors (selectable, grab, resize, text, etc.) applied to canvas based on hit targets and drag state.
summary: Fixed 3D component picking coordinates and edge hover. Picking now uses a visible clip rect (pick_bounds) aligned with the scissored viewport instead of scrolled layout bounds, fixing vertex hover offset in scrollable panels. Edge hover uses screen-space distance to projected edge segments. project_point depth check corrected for WGPU NDC (0..1). All infinite_world tests pass; WGPU WASM rebuilt.
